leadText: (Japanese: ポケットモンスター　４コマギャグバトル Pokémon 4Koma Gag Battle) is a four-panel gag featuring Pokémon, released on October 28, 1996 and was created by Yuuki Shinichi, Tsushima Naoto and Onodera Kouji. The manga was released from Publishing Co.
